crossRefs.note: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean…
Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.
Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping…
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and…

translations.web: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.
translations.bsb: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark—male and female—to keep them alive with you.
translations.kjv: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
translations.asv: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
